question_evidence_quote: The chances of making the junior high basketball team start at 10% if you're 66 inches and increase 10% for every additional inch of height.
observed_error: The response adds the increase for all three inches of growth to the baseline chance at 66 inches.
violated_condition: The increase added to the 10% baseline must correspond to final height minus 66 inches, not final height minus 65 inches.
error_description: The response adds a 30-percentage-point increase for Devin's entire three-inch growth to the 10% chance specified at 66 inches. His final height is 68 inches, only two inches above that baseline. The addition is executed correctly, but the increase uses the wrong starting height.
